_note: Phase-6 finalized constants (D6/D8: no live pricing — documented constants only, each with source + retrieved date). The API line anchors on Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct: the base Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct is not broadly hosted, so the same-size/family/generation Coder variant is the closest documented comparable (quality-parity caveat in KNOWN_LIMITATIONS).

electricity.source: Israel residential electricity price (ILS 0.666/kWh = USD 0.228), GlobalPetrolPrices Sep-2025

hardware_power._note: cpu_load_fraction = the share of CPU TDP actually drawn during inference, used to estimate CPU energy/token (measured results carry only GPU energy; cpu_energy_j_est is null). Distinct from utilization.duty_cycle (a lifetime-amortization knob).

capex._note: scope selects which CAPEX feeds the on-prem line (D6 exposed knob: gpu_only vs whole_pc). gpu_cost_usd = used RTX 3080 Ti; whole_pc_cost_usd = full Ryzen 9 5900X + 3080 Ti build.

cloud_gpu.source: RunPod RTX 3090 (managed; closest Ampere SKU to the local 3080 Ti — no cloud 3080 Ti exists). Marketplace floor ~0.13 (vast.ai).

caching._note: cached_input_discount = fraction of the input rate billed for a cache hit (cached reads ~10% of input). cached_fraction = the share of input tokens served from cache in the API+caching line.

utilization._note: the most sensitive on-prem knob (D6): fraction of wall-clock the owned box actually serves inference over its amortized life.
